_doc: Named placements a render spec can pass as `anchor` to override a preset role's own placement. Coordinates in the 1080x1920 reference space (style.json canvas.reference_width); Overlay.tsx scales them by canvas.width / reference_width (x2 at 2160x3840). See presets.ts for anchor semantics. All sit inside style.json safe_zone.

lower-left-loose._note: below the strict ads safe zone (y 1248) but inside the organic caption zone (~y 1490); author asked for it

list-center._note: top edge fixed at y 880 (below a face in the upper third, above the right rail at 1150 for up to 3 lines of tiktok-hype hook): a list header stays put while item lines are added under it (walk-2026-09-13 reel-01 'my type:')
